scope: Six-method v3 comparison with zero physical centre and observer displacement for the calibrated SCS control
checks: Calibrated SCS effective physical centre and observer displacement are exactly zero
Previous calibrated radius and step and latitude 1.1 are retained without recalibration
Original SCS and all DCS numerical settings preserved
Direct original-author transition parity in 100D and 500D
Both SCS variants retain the unchanged author JAX kernel in both comparisons
New runs repeat neither fitting nor parameter calibration
Separate 1500-transition warmup and exact first-third production burn-in
Functional ESS uses all post-burn-in scalar states including rejection repeats
Current and historical reports retain their own effective maps, labels and provenance
limitations: The retained radius and step were selected on the earlier fitted map; this release does not establish their optimality for the zero map.
Quick checks establish execution and provenance, not convergence or sampler rankings.
Quick executions overlapped with other validation; their timings are not performance evidence.
Historical pilot scores and timings are not new measurements on the zero map.
Local validation does not substitute for the published revision's platform CI status.
